usage: ink_eval.py [-h] [--data-dir DATA_DIR] [--owner OWNER] [--limit LIMIT]
                   [--stored] [--model MODEL] [--base-url BASE_URL]
                   [--include-photos] [--fixtures] [--json] [--out OUT]
                   [--per-page] [--show-diffs]

CER and WER of the handwriting recognizer on the owner's reviewed pages
(numbers and ids only).

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --data-dir DATA_DIR  the hub's DATA_DIR (default: ODYSSEUS_DATA_DIR /
                       src/constants.py)
  --owner OWNER        owner to read (repeatable; default: every ink folder)
  --limit LIMIT        at most this many pairs
  --stored             score the stored model text (transcript.machine)
                       instead of reading pages again; no model calls
  --model MODEL        read with this model instead of the vision_model
                       setting
  --base-url BASE_URL  endpoint for --model (local endpoints only)
  --include-photos     also score photo pages
  --fixtures           fictional pages in a temp DATA_DIR and a fake reader
                       (sandbox)
  --json               print the report as JSON
  --out OUT            also write the JSON report to this file
  --per-page           a row per page (ids, numbers)
  --show-diffs         print per-page line diffs: this prints page text, keep
                       it local
